<section class="hero">
  <h1>Building generative models of life&rsquo;s data, for medicine and conservation.</h1>
  <p>The Dias &amp; Frazer Group is a research group at the Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) in Barcelona, led by Mafalda Dias and Jonathan Frazer.</p>
  <p>We combine deep learning and Bayesian statistics to model biological data, from protein sequences to single cells and whole populations.</p>
  <p>Our work is built for immediate use in rare-disease diagnosis, therapeutic discovery and conservation genomics, and we develop the theory and architectures that will enable the next generation of models.</p>
  <p><a class="hiring" href="join.html#positions">We are hiring three postdocs &rarr;</a></p>
</section>
